translations.web: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
translations.bsb: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
